messages: elaine: Morning — async standup. TL;DR: landed allocator fix yesterday (PR #4123), ran end-to-end microbatch perf with kv-warmup on a 4-slot shard. What I did: patched slot allocator to avoid double-claim on backfill, added unit tests, smoke-ran microbatch harness. Blockers: seeing p95 latency increase ~18% on long-context traces when kv-warmup is enabled; not sure if it's prefetch overload or scheduling hotspot. Today: bisect between prefetch threads and slot preemption; add more tracing around KV hot path. sam: thanks — can you paste the bench numbers and the commit SHA? also is this seen on dedicated or local perf harness? elaine: commit a1f3c9d, ran on local harness + small dedicated load (2x concurrency). Key numbers: baseline (no-warmup) p50=18ms p95=72ms, with warmup p50=20ms p95=85ms. end-to-end tail spike at ~120ms occasionally. sam: hmm, 13ms tail delta is notable. can you run the quick microbench we use? bench-bot has the script: ```./tools/run_microbench --model=gpt2-small --concurrency=2 --seq=1024 --warmup=true --runs=100``` run it with `--trace=kv` and attach the .tar. tomas: I saw similar earlier — pushed kv-evict threshold tweak in my branch but didn't merge. Might be interaction between aggressive prefetch and the new slot reclaim logic. Would like to try disabling prefetcher queue coalescing. elaine: will try toggle prefetch coalescing off. also adding `--prefetch=sync` variant. nora: I can review PR #4123 this morning, ping me when you post the benchmark artifacts. I'll also open a short follow-up PR to add a small smoke test to CI to catch regressions. sam: tiny ask — please include the bench command and raw JSON output in the thread so I can triage from my laptop. also add which model/kern config used. bench-bot: microbench run queued on runner-7, job id 9876, ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand: elaine: noted. quick note on rollout: if the fix requires disabling coalescing, let's avoid rolling to prod Dedicated until we confirm no throughput hit; we can canary to one shard. sam: +1 on shard canary. also can we add a quick tracer span for `slot:reclaim` with caller tag? that'll make root cause locating easier. tomas: I'll add the span to my branch and post a tiny diff. elaine: posting logs once bench completes. thanks team :thumbsup:
